_comment: Concrete venues/pairs the tracker polls. CEX section runs out-of-the-box (public data, no keys). DEX entries with an address starting with 'TODO' are skipped until you fill them from watchlist.json -> verificationQueue.

cexSpreads.label: EURC/USDC (EUR stable, FX not peg=1)
cexSpreads.note: EUR/USD FX pair. Compare vs live EURUSD FX ref (not implemented) to spot dislocation; MiCA-gated in EEA.

dexPools.label: USDY top pool (Ondo)
dexPools.note: Fill tokenAddress; script auto-selects highest-liquidity pool. Or set poolAddress directly (Curve/Aerodrome/Solana).

dexPools.label: USDe top pool (Ethena)
dexPools.note: Fill tokenAddress from verification. GeckoTerminal networks: eth, solana, base, arbitrum, celo, stellar-not-supported.

dexPools.label: MXNe on Stabull
dexPools.note: Regional peg — FX vs on-chain. USD exit = swap to USDC then CEX withdraw.

dexPools.label: cCOP on Celo (Mento)
dexPools.note: Mento Asset Exchange; verify depth. USD exit via USDT/USDC swap then CEX.
